i18n.zhSummary: 从模型开发到半导体、机器人和工业现场。韩国的AI竞争力从何而来？为了找到答案，我们选择了 30 位领导变革的人。 THE AI 30是由《麻省理工学院技术评论》韩国编辑部独立策划，通过过去一年的跟踪报道和外部专家评审评选出的年度榜单。 《THE AI 30：30 人改变韩国人工智能的未来》一文首先出现在《麻省理工科技评论》上
i18n.enTitle: THE AI 30: 30 people changing the future of Korean AI
i18n.enSummary: From model development to semiconductors, robots, and industrial sites. Where is Korea’s AI competitiveness coming from? To find the answer, we selected 30 people who lead change. THE AI 30 is an annual list independently planned by the MIT Technology Review Korea editorial office and selected through tracking coverage over the past year and review by external experts.
